title: Testing: WASM integration tests for GitHubClient
body:
Add wasm-bindgen-test integration tests for the GitHub API client.

- Add wasm-bindgen-test as dev-dependency
- Create tests/ directory with WASM integration tests
- Mock HTTP responses to test GitHubClient methods: response parsing (200/error/malformed), 401 handling, list_contents fallback, create_or_update_file request body
- Evaluate gloo-net mocking options (may need trait-based HTTP abstraction or mockito-style approach)
- Run with: wasm-pack test --headless --chrome
